raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly resolved the Rhine-crossing timeframe to “end of 405,” despite available evidence indicating the invasion occurred at the end of 406 (traditionally December 31, 406). This unsupported reinterpretation of the 405–406 winter range contradicted sources already found (e.g., Wikipedia and Britannica snippets) and led to the wrong year.
